summary: Single player works from a new player to the end of the story (quest 979). Multiplayer, events and raids do not exist yet.

areas.name: Startup and home screen
areas.detail: The original, unmodified 4.3.1 Android client starts, creates a new player, plays the Prologue and reaches the home screen.

areas.name: Story quests
areas.detail: Quests 1-979 on the original maps and rooms, with cutscenes, per-quest music, original enemy stats and levels, objectives, chests and Trophies.

areas.name: Combat
areas.detail: Special Attacks with variable damage, enemy attacks, Lux levels up to 999.

areas.name: Medals
areas.detail: Medal List, selling, Level Up (Special Attack dots and Bonus, Skills, traits, Trait Medals), Evolve.

areas.name: Shop
areas.detail: The original banners: 807 deals with their guarantees, pity, weekly rotation, seasonal banners, a kept banner and a filterable catalog.

areas.name: Moogle Shop
areas.detail: Medals and items exchanged for Moogle points.

areas.name: Missions and Login Bonus
areas.detail: Daily, weekly and Limited missions, campaigns and the daily Login Bonus.

areas.name: Profile, Avatar Boards, pet
areas.detail: Profile, avatar parts and Avatar Boards, the pet.

areas.name: In-game Notices
areas.detail: Every difference from the original game is explained in the Notices, inside the game and on this site.

areas.name: Enemy graphics (quests 526-979)
areas.detail: 142 enemy families have their original look; about 88 are still missing and are shown with the look of a similar enemy. Their files are lost: see How to help.

areas.name: Guest allies
areas.detail: The allies who fight at your side in some story quests (Hercules, Aladdin, Ralph, Ephemer...): being fixed, to be verified.

areas.name: Proud Mode
areas.detail: The hard version of the story quests: research done, original layouts being imported.

areas.name: Easy installation
areas.detail: Today the setup is long and technical. A launcher will make it simple when the work is finished.

areas.name: Events
areas.detail: Event quests, event banners and boosters.

areas.name: Raid Bosses
areas.detail: Raid Boss battles and their rewards.

areas.name: Union Cross and PvP
areas.detail: Realtime multiplayer: needs a self-hosted Photon server (phase E).
